name: drawing-office
description: Architecture diagrams as a versioned model, with the palette, the step order and the label collisions all checked rather than eyeballed.

scripts.export: structurizr-cli export -w architecture/internet-banking/workspace.dsl -f json -o architecture/internet-banking && structurizr-cli export -w architecture/internet-banking/workspace.dsl -f static -o architecture/internet-banking/site
scripts.check: node checks/diagram-contrast.mjs && node checks/palette-claim.mjs && node checks/legibility.mjs && node checks/model.mjs > /dev/null && node checks/test-model.mjs && node checks/derived.mjs && node checks/delivery.mjs && node checks/pubsub.mjs && node checks/perspectives.mjs && node checks/decisions.mjs && node checks/diagram-key.mjs && node checks/site-fresh.mjs && node checks/named-controls.mjs && node checks/test-viewer.mjs && node checks/test-trace-suggest.mjs && node checks/test-tools.mjs
scripts.negative: node checks/diagram-contrast.mjs --negative && node checks/palette-claim.mjs --negative && node checks/style-resolve.mjs --negative && node checks/named-controls.mjs --negative && node checks/legibility.mjs --negative && node checks/derived.mjs --negative && node checks/delivery.mjs --negative && node checks/pubsub.mjs --negative && node checks/perspectives.mjs --negative && node checks/decisions.mjs --negative && node checks/diagram-key.mjs --negative && node checks/site-fresh.mjs --negative && node checks/test-viewer.mjs --negative && node tools/reading-aids.mjs --negative && node tools/trace-suggest.mjs --negative && node tools/trace-animate.mjs --negative && node tools/serve.mjs --negative
